title: Tracing Beam
description: A line of light that travels down the page as you read, filling the rail beside the text.
usage: For long reads — guides, changelogs, case studies — where knowing how far in you are is kindness. The fill is the scroll fraction of the container beside it, nothing more mystical. Pair it with a Scrollspy when the reader also needs to jump; use it alone when they only need to feel progress.
a11y: The beam is a progress picture, aria-hidden, duplicating what the scrollbar already says. Content never depends on it, and under prefers-reduced-motion the rail stays a plain hairline.
